n-k-k2-01.title: Ibango malunga neklasi yonke
n-k-k2-01.goal: Sebenzisa ukuzazisa njengobungqina ukugqiba ukuba isivakalisi ngomntu wonke siyinyani na, ubone ukuba zingaphi izinto ezingaphandle ezisiphulayo, ubhale isivakalisi esifanelana nobungqina.
n-k-k2-01.material:
Iklasi yakho inengqokelela yencoko. Iklasi inabafundi abane. Nganye ibhale ukuzazisa okufutshane ngokutya. Emva koko 수진 wabhala isivakalisi ngeklasi.

민호: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 매일 먹어요.
에밀리: 저는 김치를 안 좋아해요. 불고기를 좋아해요.
지아: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 그런데 매운 김치는 못 먹어요.
토마스: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 지난주에 처음 먹었어요.

수진: 우리 반 네 명은 모두 김치를 좋아해요.

(모두 = bonke.)
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.prompt: 수진 uthi BONKE abafundi abane bayakuthanda i-kimchi. Sisiphi isivakalisi somfundi esibonisa ukuba ibango lakhe alilonyani?
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumfundi ngamnye, gqiba ukuba isivakalisi sikuxelela ukuba uyayithanda i-kimchi na.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Gcina izivakalisi eziphendula ngqo 'Ngaba lo mntu uyayithanda i-kimchi?' kuphela, uzithelekise nesivakalisi sika-수진.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.a: Ukuyitya yonke imihla kuxhasa ibango; akunakubonisa ukuba umntu akayithandi i-kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.b: Jonga ukuzazisa kwonke: 지아 naye uthi uyayithanda i-kimchi. Akakwazi ukutya eyi-spicy, nto leyo engafani nokungayithandi i-kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.d: Ukuyitya okokuqala kwiveki ephelileyo akuthi nto ngokuba uyayithanda na.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.explain: Ngu-에밀리 kuphela ophendula nge-hayi kwi-'Do you like kimchi?' Isibhengezo malunga nabo bonke siphulwa ngumntu omnye ongavumiyo. Ezinye izivakalisi zimalunga nokuba kungakanani, kubukhali kangakanani okanye nini, hayi ngokuthanda.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.prompt: Isivakalisi sika-수진 sithi 모두 (bonke). Bangaphi kubafundi abane abafunda nabo abafanele bangavumi ukuze isivakalisi sakhe singabi yinyani?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba iklasi inabafundi abayi-100. Bangaphi abantu abangayithandiyo i-kimchi ekufuneka ubafumane?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.1: 'All of them like it' yinyani kuphela ukuba akukho bani oshiyiweyo. Bala ukuba mingaphi imiba ephula oko.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.a: Ababini bangaphezu koko kufunekayo. 'All' yenza isithembiso ngomntu ngamnye.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.c: Abathathu bangaphezu koko kufunekayo. 'All' yenza isithembiso ngomntu ngamnye.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.d: Abane bangaphezu kakhulu koko kufunekayo. 'All like it' isoloko iphosakala kwangoko xa umntu omnye engayithandi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.explain: 'All' yenza isithembiso malunga nomntu ngamnye, ngoko isiphoso esinye sanele ukuyiphula. Isivakalisi esifana ne-'대부분' (uninzi) sinokuhlala ngeziphoso ezimbalwa.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala isivakalisi SESINYE sesiKorea esinembeko malunga ne-kimchi nabafundi abane abafunda nabo esiyinyani kwiintshayelelo ezine.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Gqiba kuqala ukuba bangaphi kubane abayithandayo i-kimchi, uze ubhale isivakalisi esiyinyani kweli qela kanye.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khangela isivakalisi sakho ngentshayelelo ka-에밀리 phambi kokugqiba.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isivakalisi sam siyinyani kuzo ZONKE iintshayelelo ezine, kuquka eka-에밀리?

n-k-k2-02.title: Ingaba inqaku lihambelana nencoko?
n-k-k2-02.goal: Thelekisa isishwankathelo esibhaliweyo nencoko yokuqala, ufumane imigca etshintshe inkcukacha, uthi luhlobo luni lwenkcukacha olutshintshileyo, uze ubhale isishwankathelo esilungisiweyo.
n-k-k2-02.material:
민수 no-지나 bacwangcisa ngoMgqibelo ngencoko. Emva koko 지나 ubhalela umama wakhe inqaku.

민수: 지나 씨, 토요일 오후 두 시에 학교 앞에서 만나요.
민수: 영화는 세 시 반에 시작해요. 영화를 보고 저녁을 먹어요.
민수: 저녁을 먹고 아홉 시에 집에 가요.
지나: 네, 좋아요!

(앞 = phambi kwe-. 집에 가요 = hamba ekhaya.)
n-k-k2-02.prereq.0: Uyawazi amagama exesha esiKorea (두 시, 아홉 시)
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.prompt: 지나 ubhalela umama wakhe inqaku. Eminye imigca ayihambelani nencoko. Khetha umgca omnye wenqaku ongahambelaniyo nencoko.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Dlula kwinqaku umgca ngomgca ufumane inkcukacha efanayo kwincoko: ngubani, yiliphi ilanga, phi, ngeliphi ixesha.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, thi ingaba incoko inika indawo okanye ixesha ngayo na, uze uthelekise amagama enye ngenye.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.explain: Imigca emibini ayihambelani nencoko. Umgca 2 uthi badibana phambi kwesinema, kodwa 민수 wabhala 학교 앞 (phambi kwesikolo). Umgca 5 uthi 여덟 시 (8 o'clock), kodwa 민수 wabhala 아홉 시 (9 o'clock). Imigca 1, 3 no-4 iyahambelana.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.prompt: Imigca engalunganga yenqaku yahluka kwincoko ngeendlela ezimbini ezahlukileyo. Sesiphi isibini?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hlela inkcukacha yesicwangciso ibe ngamaqela: ngubani, yiliphi ilanga, phi, ngeliphi ixesha.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Aloluphi amaqela amabini aqulathe inkcukacha etshintshileyo phakathi kwencoko nenqaku?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.explain: Inqaku litshintsha apho badibana khona (영화관 endaweni ye-학교) nexesha abaya ekhaya ngalo (여덟 시 endaweni ye-아홉 시). Ngubani nelanga zichanekile.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale inqaku kumama ngesiKorea esichanekileyo esinembeko (izivakalisi ezi-2 okanye ezi-3 ezimfutshane). Sebenzisa incoko ukunika indawo yokudibana, ixesha lokudibana nexesha aya ngalo ekhaya.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dwelisa kuqala iinkcukacha ezintathu: apho badibana khona, xa badibana, xa aya ekhaya.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kopa inkcukacha nganye kwimiyalezo ka-민수 ugcine ixesha ngalinye nesicwangciso salo, uze wongeze iziphelo ezinembeko (-요).
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba zonke iindawo namaxesha kwinqaku lam ziyahambelana nencoko?
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba umama wam angazi ukuba aphi nini ukundilindela?

n-k-k2-03.title: Isimemo esinezithuba
n-k-k2-03.goal: Gqiba ukuba ziziphi iinyani ezilahlekileyo kwisimemo esifutshane, uqaphele ukuba impendulo engacacanga ayonelanga, uze ucele oko ukufunayo.
n-k-k2-03.material:
Kwiveki ephelileyo wadibana no-지호 kwiklasi yolwimi. Namhlanje ukuthumelele umyalezo. Awukaze uye ekhaya lakhe.

지호: 토요일에 우리 집에서 파티를 해요. 꼭 오세요!

(꼭 = nceda uqiniseke ukuba uza.)
n-k-k2-03.prereq.0: Uyawazi amagama ombuzo asisiseko (몇 시, 어디)
n-k-k2-03.prereq.2: Ungathi 'ndiza kuya' kunye no'enkosi' ngesiKorea esilula esinembeko (갈게요, 고마워요), kuchazwe kwiingcebiso
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukuya. Yimiphi imibuzo ekufuneka uyibuze phambi kokuba ufike ngokwenene kwitheko? Khetha yonke into oyifunayo ngokwenene.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba ngumhla woMgqibelo ekuseni kwaye ufuna ukuhamba. Yintoni enokukuthintela ukuba uhambe?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hlela imibuzo: yeyiphi enceda ufike, kwaye yeyiphi elungileyo ukwazi nje?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.b: Inani leendwendwe ezizayo alitshintshi ukuba ungayifumana indawo okanye ufike ngexesha.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.d: Iluncedo kwaye inembeko ukuyibuza, kodwa ungafika ungayazi. Ayifuneki ukufika apho.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.e: Ukwazi isihlandlo kunokukunceda ukhethe isipho, kodwa akukuxeleli nini okanye phi ukuya.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.explain: Umyalezo unika ilanga (토요일) kodwa akukho xesha, kwaye 우리 집 ayikuxeleli idilesi yomntu ongazange waya kuye. Ixesha nendawo ziinyani ezimbini ozifunayo ukuze ufike.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.acc.0: Ukubuza ukuba mazisiwe ntoni kunobubele kwaye kulungile. Akufuneki nje ukuze ufike kwindawo elungileyo nexesha elilungileyo.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.prompt: 지호 uphendula imibuzo yakho ngomgca omnye kuphela: '저녁에 오세요.' Ngoku uyazi ngokwaneleyo ngexesha?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba igama 저녁 linokugubungela iiyure ezingaphi.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zibuze: ngaba iindwendwe ezimbini zinokufunda esi sivakalisi zifike emva kweeyure ezintathu?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.a: Ewe. 저녁 lixesha, ngoko ndingafika naliphi na ixesha kusasa.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.a: 저녁 (kusasa) ligubungela iiyure ezininzi. Ukuba ufika kamva, usenokuphoswa yimvuthuluka; ukuba ufika kwangethuba, kusenokungabikho namnye ulungile.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.b: Hayi okwangoku. 저녁 ligubungela iiyure ezininzi, ngoko ndisafuna iyure echanekileyo.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.c: Ewe. Ndiyalazi ilanga nenxalenye yosuku, ngoko ndingacwangcisa ukufika kwam.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.c: Ilanga nenxalenye yosuku zisengekho ixesha elichanekileyo lokufika.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.d: Hayi okwangoku. 저녁 ithetha 'isidlo sangokuhlwa', ngoko kufuneka ndibuze ukuba ukutya kuyanikwa na.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.d: 저녁 inokuthetha 'kusasa' okanye 'isidlo sangokuhlwa'. Apha ligama lexesha ngenxa ye-에 ne-오세요, kwaye ukutya akunakukuxelela ukuba ufika nini.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.explain: 저녁 ligama nje lenxalenye yosuku. Ukuze ufike ngexesha elililo kusafuneka iyure, umzekelo 여섯 시.
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokumbulela okanye ngokuthi uza kuza (고마워요 = enkosi, 갈게요 = ndiza kuya).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.1: Zeziphi iinyani ezisuka kuluhlu lwakho lwemibuzo yangaphambili umntu azifunayo phambi kokuhamba ekhaya? Zicele ngesiphelo esinembeko (-요).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba impendulo yam inembeko ngokwaneleyo kumntu endimaziyo kwiveki nje ephelileyo?

n-k-k2-04.title: Ingqayi enemithetho
n-k-k2-04.goal: Funda iimeko ezininzi kwincoko emfutshane yokuthenga, uze wakhe ingqayi enye ngaphezulu ehlangabezana nazo zonke, uze uxele ingqayi enye ngesiKorea.
n-k-k2-04.material:
민지: 오늘 시장에서 과일을 사요. 사과는 한 개에 천 원, 귤은 한 개에 오백 원이에요.
민지: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요. 그런데 사과가 귤보다 적어요.
민지: 과일은 모두 일곱 개 이상 사요. 오천 원을 넘으면 안 돼요.

(이상 = eli nani okanye ngaphezulu. 넘으면 안 돼요 = akufanele kudlule. -보다 = kunga-.)
n-k-k2-04.thinking.2: Ukubona ukuba imida ivumela iimpendulo ezininzi
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.prompt: Kumyalezo wesibini ka-민지, '사과가 귤보다 적어요' ikuxelela ntoni ngengqayi?
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana ukuba sesiphi isiqhamo esisisiqu (esimaliswe nge-가) nesiphi esithelekiswa naso (esimaliswe nge-보다).
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funda 적어요 njenge-'linani elincinci' uze ugqibe ukuba sesiphi isiqhamo esinexabiso elincinci.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.a: 적어요 ithetha 'ezimbalwa / ngaphantsi'. -보다 imakisha into oyithelekisa nayo, ngoko ii-apile linani elincinci.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.b: Isivakalisi sithelekisa amanani amabini sithi elinye lincinci; asithi ayalingana.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.d: Umgca wangaphambili uthi 사과도 사고, ngoko ii-apile zikwingqayi; 적어요 ithi 'ezimbalwa', hayi 'akukho'.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.explain: A (사과가) B (귤보다) 적어요 = A incinci kuneB. Ngoko inani lee-apile lincinci kunenani leetangerini.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.prompt: Umntu ucebisa ii-apile ezi-3 neetangerini ezi-5. Yeyiphi kwiimeko zika-민지 eyaphulwa yile ngqayi?
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Khangela iimeko enye ngenye ngamanani ama-3 nawe-5.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kwimeko yemali, bala ixabiso lee-apile neleetangerini ngokwahlukeneyo, uze udibanise.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.b: Ii-apile ezi-3 zimbalwa kuneetangerini ezi-5, ngoko le meko ilungile.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.c: 3 + 5 = 8 iziqwenga zesiqhamo, ezingama-7 okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko oku kulungile.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.d: Ingqayi inazo zombini ii-apile neetangerini, ngoko oku kulungile.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.explain: Ii-apile ezi-3 zixabisa 3,000 won kwaye iitangerini ezi-5 zixabisa 2,500 won, kunye 5,500 won. Oko kungaphezu kwe-5,000. Ezinye iimeko ezintathu ziyahlangatyezwa.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.prompt: Fumana iingqayi ezi-3 ezahlukileyo ezanelisa YONKE imeko kwimiyalezo ka-민지. a = inani lee-apile (사과), t = inani leetangerini (귤).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.0: Beka iimeko ngamazwi akho kuqala: ii-apile ezimbalwa kuneetangerini, iziqwenga ezi-7 ubuncinane, 5,000 won ubuninzi.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Zama ii-apile ezi-1 uze ufumane inani leetangerini elenza iziqwenga ezi-7 ubuncinane; emva koko khangela ixabiso.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.2: Khangela imali ekugqibeleni: 1,000 x ii-apile + 500 x iitangerini, uze utshintshe inani lee-apile.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c0: Thenga iziqwenga zesiqhamo ezipheleleyo kuphela (inani eliphelele le-개).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c1: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요: ubuncinane isinye sazo zozibini.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c2: 사과가 귤보다 적어요: ii-apile kufuneka zibe ngaphantsi kweetangerini.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c3: 일곱 개 이상: iziqwenga zesiqhamo ezi-7 ubuncinane zizonke.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c4: Isixa singaphezu kwe-5,000 won (i-apile 1,000 nganye, itangerini 500 nganye).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.explain: Umzekelo i-apile e-1 + iitangerini ezi-7 = 4,500 won; 2 + 5 = 4,500 won; 3 + 4 = 5,000 won. Iingqayi ezininzi ziyafaneleka kuba imiyalezo inika imida, hayi i-oda enye echanekileyo.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Khetha ENYE yeengqayi zakho uxelele 민지 ngomyalezo omfutshane onembeko ukuba uza kuthenga ii-apile neetangerini ezingaphi nexabiso elipheleleyo.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Thatha ingqayi enye kuluhlu olungasentla uze ubhale amanani ayo amabini.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Yitha ii-apile, emva koko iitangerini, emva koko isixa ngo-won.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba amanani akumyalezo wam ahambelana neengqayi endizakhileyo?
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba isixa sichanekile (1,000 x ii-apile + 500 x iitangerini)?

n-k-k2-05.title: Ngubani owenzileyo? Isivakalisi asithi
n-k-k2-05.goal: Landela incoko emfutshane eshiya iziqu, uqaphele ukuba ukufunda kwakho ukuba ngubani owenze ntoni kutshintsha njani, uze ubhale kwakhona isivakalisi ukuze akukho bani onokusifunda kakubi.
n-k-k2-05.material: 하나 uthetha nomhlobo wakhe 준호 ngempelaveki ephelileyo. KwisiKorea isiqu sihlala sishiywa xa sibonakala sicacile. Funda kancinci: ibali lisezahlulweni ezintathu.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda inxalenye nganye, ukhethe indlela yokufunda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu, uze uqhubeke. Impendulo yakho inokutshintsha njengoko ufunda ngakumbi.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba ngawaphi amagama achaza umntu nokuba ngazaphi izenzi ezingenamntu zincanyathiselwe kuzo.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Isivakalisi sesibini asinasihloko. IsiKorea sihlala sishiya isihloko esicacileyo kwimeko, kodwa apha umzala (동생이) ngowokugqibela ukukhankanywa kwaye 하나 ngumthethi, ngoko ngeli xesha awunakuqiniseka.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Isivakalisi sithi 만들었어요, ngoko umntu uyenzile, kodwa abantu ababodwa kwibali ngu-하나 nomzala wakhe omncinci.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: 하나 mhlawumbi wayenze yena, kodwa uphendule umbuzo ngobugcisa bomzala wakhe, ngoko lusafundo nje olunokwenzeka.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 하나 uthi umzala wakhe akakwazi ukupheka, ngoko oku akunakwenzeka, kodwa akakathi ngubani opheke.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Inxalenye yokuqala ithi 만들었어요 (yenziwe), ngoko umntu uyipheke.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Impendulo yakhe ngobugcisa bomzala. Ayithi wabelana ngokupheka.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 먹었어요 kwakhona ayinasihloko. Kuyindalo ukuba ngu-하나, mhlawumbi kunye nomzala wakhe. Xa umntu ephawulwe ngokucacileyo (동생이 했어요), uphawu lukuxelela ukuba ngubani; xa kungekho phawu, kufuneka usebenzise imeko kwaye ngamanye amaxesha ubuze.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 하나 nguye othe 제가 만들었어요; akukho nto ephawula umzala yedwa njengothe wadla. 설거지는 동생이 inophawu, kodwa 먹었어요 ayinaso.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 맛있게 먹었어요 ithi yadliwa yaza yonwatyelwa.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.reflect: IsiKorea sihlala sishiya isihloko xa imeko siyinika, kodwa umntu wokugqibela owafundayo akasoloko enguye owenza isenzo esilandelayo. Khangela iimpawu (이/가, 은/는, 제가) kwaye ugcine ufundo luvulekile xa kungekho phawu. Ukuba kubalulekile, buza.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kwakhona izivakalisi ezimbini zokuqala zika-하나 ngesiKorea esinembeko ukuze kungabikho umntu ongaqondi kakuhle ukuba ngubani owenze i-bibimbap: ngu-하나 ngokwakhe, njengoko ufundile encokweni. Okokuqala: 어제 동생이 우리 집에 왔어요. 비빔밥을 만들었어요.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa isivakalisi sakho nesokuqala: yeyiphi ingcaciso engekhoyo kwisivakalisi sesibini?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isikhubekiso emva kwegama lomntu (-가 / -이) sibonisa ukuba lo mntu wenze isenzo.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Umfundi angazi na ukuba ngubani owenze i-bibimbap ngaphandle kokujonga incoko?
